lines.text: Pandora's box was never actually a box.
In the original Greek story, it was a large jar, called a pithos.
Zeus had Pandora created as a punishment, after Prometheus stole fire and gave it to humans.
When she opened the jar, out flew sickness, hard work, and every kind of trouble.
Only one thing stayed inside. Hope.
So where did the box come from? About five hundred years ago, the scholar Erasmus translated it as a box, and the mistake stuck.
Follow for more myths you were told wrong!
